transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Okay, Tuesday the twenty-third. We need to close out the backup supplier question today. Marcus, can you recap?

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Sure. So we looked at three, um, Lotus Valley Imports, Eastfield Teas, and Pemberton. Pemberton is out, the minimum order is too high.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Agreed, Pemberton's minimum is like triple.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Eastfield is cheaper per kilo but the lead time is five weeks. Lotus Valley is about ten days.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Which is the same as Kessler, so it works as a backup.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Right. So is it Lotus Valley?

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: I'd say yes.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Yes. The customers care about the delivery more than price.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Yes from me.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Okay, Lotus Valley is the backup supplier. Decision made.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Great.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: What about the clause? I read the contract, and there's an exclusivity clause, um, that says we would buy all our oolong from them.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: That's a no-go. We have Kessler for oolong.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Agreed. We do not sign the exclusivity clause. Anybody disagree?

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: No.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: No.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: No, I'll ask legal to take it out. I'll do that tomorrow, because they need the day.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Tomorrow's the twenty-fourth, thanks.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Yep.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Did you folks see the thing on the news about the tea tax?

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: No, what thing?

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: It's nothing, the usual. It's about import duty, it won't happen until next year, if it happens.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Let's not go down there. We would only be guessing.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Okay, so, the order form. Who sends it?

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: I can. I'll send the signed order form to Lotus Valley by Friday.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Friday the twenty-sixth. Okay.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Yeah, as long as legal is done with the clause, which should be fine.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: And, um, the discount. They said, over a ton a year they would do ten percent.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: I think we can do better. I'll negotiate the volume discount with Lotus Valley. I know the owner a little.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: I actually already have a call with their sales person on Thursday. I'll negotiate the discount with them then.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Oh. Sofia, are you? We would both be on it.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Hm. I thought you were not going to.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: I said I'd do it.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Okay. We'll sort it out after.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Please do, I don't want two people with two different numbers.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Yes, yes, sorry.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Now the sample. The first sample shipment from Lotus Valley arrives next Monday.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: And someone checks quality.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: I will run the sample quality check. Moisture, a taste panel, the usual.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: By when?

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: By Tuesday the thirtieth. And I'll share the results with the team when I'm done, same day.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Okay. Good.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Um, can I also, maybe I could write the comparison down in the wiki? So we remember why we chose them. I think it would be useful. I'll try, but the next two days I'm in the customer workshop.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: That would be useful.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Hey, quick thing, the order form. The twenty-sixth is the Friday, but our finance cut-off is Monday. So I'll send the signed order form to Lotus Valley on Monday the twenty-ninth.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Monday the twenty-ninth, okay. Not Friday?

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: No, sorry, Monday. The cut-off, the bank, it's a thing.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Alright. I'll note it.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: And so, actually, to restate, the sample quality check is mine, due Tuesday. The results go to the team that same day.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Yes, we heard.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Okay, just making sure.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: What about Kessler? Somebody should, you know, tell them about it. Who is going to tell Kessler Farms we are adding a backup?

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Hm. They might take it badly.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Not me, I deal with their invoices only.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Don't look at me.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Priya normally does the relationship, but she's out.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Okay. Unclear for now.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Maybe we should just set up a call with their account manager and be open about it. Like, a friendly call.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: That's a nice way to do it.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: It is. Hold it as a suggestion until Priya is back.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Good. Thank you, everyone.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Thanks.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Bye.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Bye.
